y-m-64-06.title: Ithuba lishintsha kanjani njengoba ulwazi lwengezwa ucezu ngalunye ngesikhathi?
y-m-64-06.topic: Ithuba elinombandela: ukuthi ithuba lishintsha kanjani njengoba ulwazi lwengezwa
y-m-64-06.goal: Landela, ngokubala amacala, ukuthi njalo uma kufika ulwazi olusha amacala angenzeka ancipha futhi ithuba likhuphuka, lihlala linjalo, noma liba ngu-1.
y-m-64-06.material: I-die ebomvu ne-die eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ngayinye ijikijelwa kanye. Ama-die amabili alungile futhi awathintani, futhi ubuso ngabunye kusukela ku-1 kuya ku-6 buvela ngethuba elilinganayo. Uma isamba sobuso obubili singu-8 noma ngaphezulu, kubizwa 'ngempumelelo'. Umphumela awukaziwa, futhi ulwazi lunikezwa ucezu ngalunye ngesikhathi.
y-m-64-06.thinking.0: Bheka ukuthi ulwazi olusha lushintsha kanjani amacala angenzeka
y-m-64-06.thinking.1: Sho izizathu zokubuyekeza noma ukugcina isinqumo
y-m-64-06.prereq.0: 'H1' kulo msebenzi iyinkomba nje yezinga lobunzima nokusekelwa kulokhu kwabelwa kokukhiqiza futhi ayisho ukuthi ikharikhulamu inikeza lesi sifundo unyaka othile wesikole. Icabanga ukuthi usuhlangane, ku-Probability and Statistics yesikole samabanga aphezulu, nendlela yokuthola ithuba njengo-(inani lamacala enzekayo) ÷ (inani lawo wonke amacala).
y-m-64-06.prereq.1: Isipiliyoni sokuhlela ubuso bama-die amabili njengamapheya ahleliwe angu-36 (ubuso be-die ebomvu, ubuso be-die eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka)
y-m-64-06.prereq.2: Umbono wokugcina kuphela amacala afanela ulwazi olunikeziwe
y-m-64-06.s.s1.prompt: Ulwazi luvezwa ucezu ngalunye ngesikhathi. Njalo, khetha ukuthi ithuba 'lempumelelo' likhulu kangakanani.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.hint.0: Njalo uma uthola ulwazi, bhala amacala angu-36 etafuleni, wacishe amaseli angafaneli ulwazi, bese ubala amaseli asele.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.hint.1: Bala inani lamaseli asele anesamba esingu-8 noma ngaphezulu, bhala isilinganiso, bese usiqhathanisa eceleni nesilinganiso sesinyathelo esandulele.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.0.info: Lokhu kungaphambi kokujikijela. Alukho ulwazi ngobuso okwamanje.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ithuba lempumelelo (isamba sobuso obubili singu-8 noma ngaphezulu) likhulu kangakanani?
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.0.after: Amacala anesamba esingu-8, 9, 10, 11, 12 angu-5, 4, 3, 2, 1 izindlela ngokulandelana, ngakho izindlela ezingu-15 sonke. Ithuba ngu-15/36 = 5/12.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uma ubhala wonke amacala anesamba esingu-8, 9, 10, 11, 12, akuyona izindlela ezingu-12. Hlola ukuthi zingaki izindlela ezilahlekile kusukela kusiphi isamba.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Lesi isilinganiso esithathe inani eliphakathi lezamba, 7, njengomugqa wokuhlukanisa futhi sabuka njengengxenye nengxenye. Izindlela ezingu-6 ezinesamba esingu-7 azizona izimpumelelo.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Lokhu kuyavumelana nenani lokubala amacala anesamba esingu-8, 9, 10, 11, 12 nokuwengeza.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Lokhu kungase kube yisilinganiso esizwe ukuthi '8 noma ngaphezulu' ibanga elibanzi phakathi kwezamba ezingu-6 (7 kuya ku-12). Uma isamba sikhula, amacala ayancipha.

y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.1.after: Amacala anesamba esiyisibili angu-18 izindlela (izamba 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 zinezindlela ezingu-1, 3, 5, 5, 3, 1 ngokulandelana), futhi phakathi kwawo impumelelo (izamba 8, 10, 12) ingu-9 izindlela. Ithuba ngu-9/18 = 1/2, elaba likhulu kuno-5/12.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Lokhu kuyavumelana nenani lokubala, phakathi kwezindlela ezingu-18 ezinesamba esiyisibili, izindlela ezingu-5 + 3 + 1 = 9 ezinesamba esingu-8, 10, 12.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ulwazi lokuthi isamba siyisibili lunciphisa amacala angenzeka lusuka ezindleleni ezingu-36 lufike ezindleleni ezingu-18. Udinga ukubala futhi phakathi kwamacala anciphisiwe.

y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Uma ugcina kuphela amacala anesamba esiyisibili, isabelo samacala anesamba esingu-8, 10, 12 empeleni siba nkulu. Bala wena amacala asele.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Lakhula kakhulu, laba cishe ngu-5/6 noma ngaphezulu
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Amacala anesamba esiyisibili afaka nezamba 2, 4, 6. Amacala amaningi angewona izimpumelelo asasele.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.2.info: Umfundi wengeza: 'Isamba siyisibili, futhi ubuso bama-die amabili buhlukile komunye nomunye.'
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.2.after: Amacala anesamba esiyisibili nobuso obuhlukile angu-18 - 6 = 12 izindlela, futhi phakathi kwawo izimpumelelo zingu-9 - 3 = 6 izindlela. Ithuba ngu-6/12 = 1/2, lihlala linjalo. Amacala angu-3 empumelelo (4,4), (5,5), (6,6) asusiwe ndawonye, ngakho isilinganiso asishintshanga.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Uma ususa amacala lapho ubuso bufana, amacala empumelelo nawo ayasuswa. Bala ukuthi kususwa malini ohlangothini ngalunye.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Hlola ukuthi ucabange ukuthi amacala anobuso obufanayo asohlangothini lwalokho okungeyona impumelelo kuphela yini. Zingaphi izamba zika-(4,4), (5,5), (6,6)?
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Kwengezwe ulwazi olusha, ngakho kufanele lushintshe
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ulwazi olusha alushintshi njalo ithuba. Bala amacala asele bese uhlola isilinganiso wena.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Lesi sinqumo esibalile ukuhlola ukuthi noma amacala anobuso obufanayo asuswa, amacala empumelelo nawo asuswa ngesilinganiso esifanayo.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.3.info: Lolu ulwazi lokugcina. Utshelwa ukuthi ubuso be-die ebomvu bungu-6. (Isamba siyisibili, futhi ubuso obubili buhlukile.)
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.3.after: Uma ubuso obubomvu bungu-6 futhi isamba siyisibili, ubuso obuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka bungabo obunye bwa-2, 4, 6, futhi njengoba ubuso obubili buhlukile, u-6 uyashiywa, kusala u-2 noma 4. Isamba singu-8 noma 10, bobabili 8 noma ngaphezulu, ngakho ithuba lingu-1.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.3.r.a: Uma ubuso be-die ebomvu bumisiwe, ubuso obungenzeka be-die eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka buyancipha kakhulu. Bhala wena amacala asele.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.3.r.b: Lesi sinqumo siqinisekise ukuthi amacala asele ngobuso obuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka 2 no-4 kuphela, izamba zabo ezingu-8 no-10, zombili izimpumelelo.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.3.r.c: Ungahlola ngokubhala wena ukuthi phakathi kwamacala asele kukhona yini angewona izimpumelelo.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.3.r.d: Bala elilodwa ngelilodwa izamba zamacala lapho ubuso obubomvu bungu-6, isamba siyisibili, futhi ubuso obuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka abuyona u-6.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.reflect: Ithuba lishintshe njengo-5/12 → 1/2 → 1/2 → 1. Yiziphi izingcezu zolwazi ezishintshe ithuba nokuthi yiziphi ezingashintshanga? Sho ukuthi kwenzekani uma ulwazi lunciphisa amacala angenzeka futhi amacala empumelelo namacala angewona impumelelo ancipha ngesilinganiso esifanayo.
y-m-64-06.s.s2.prompt: Esinyathelweni sesi-3, kwengezwe ulwazi 'ubuso obubili buhlukile' kodwa ithuba alishintshanga. Chaza ukuthi kungani lingashintshanga, usebenzisa izinombolo zamacala asele.
y-m-64-06.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala amacala angu-6 asusiwe esinyathelweni sesi-3 etafuleni bese ubala ukuthi mangaki awo anesamba esingu-8 noma ngaphezulu.
y-m-64-06.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala 'inani lamacala empumelelo ÷ inani lawo wonke amacala' ngaphambi nangemva kokususa bese uyaqhathanisa.
y-m-64-06.s.s2.placeholder: Isibonelo: Noma sisusa amacala anobuso obufanayo, ...
y-m-64-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe usho inani lamacala empumelelo (4,4), (5,5), (6,6) phakathi kwalawo asusiwe (amacala angu-6 anobuso obufanayo)?
y-m-64-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uyibeke ngamazwi akho iphuzu lokuthi 'ulwazi olusha alushintshi njalo ithuba'?
y-m-64-06.s.s2.model.0: Kumacala angu-6 anobuso obufanayo, lawo anesamba esingu-8 noma ngaphezulu angamacala angu-3 (4,4), (5,5), (6,6), ingxenye ngqo. Phakathi kwezindlela ezingu-18 ezinesamba esiyisibili, impumelelo bekungu-9 izindlela, ingxenye, ngakho noma ngemva kokususa amacala angu-6 anobuso obufanayo, impumelelo ingu-6 kwezindlela ezingu-12 ezisele, futhi isilinganiso sihlala ngu-1/2.
y-m-64-06.s.s2.model.1: Noma sisusa amacala anobuso obufanayo, isabelo esinesamba esingu-8 noma ngaphezulu phakathi kwamacala asele sisengxenye (6/12), ngakho ithuba alishintshanga. Ulwazi olusha lunciphise amacala angenzeka, kodwa lunciphise amacala empumelelo nawo angewona impumelelo ngesilinganiso esifanayo.

y-m-64-09.title: Singakwazi ukuphatha inani lempumelelo kulesi simo njengokuphindaphindwa okunethuba elifanayo?
y-m-64-09.topic: Ukusabalaliswa kwe-binomial: izimo lapho imodeli ifanela nezimo lapho ingafaneli
y-m-64-09.goal: Hlulela, isimo ngesimo, ukuthi yiziphi izimo ezidingekayo ukuphatha inani lempumelelo ezivivinyweni eziphindaphindwayo njenge-binomial, futhi uqinisekise ngezinombolo ukuthi umphumela wokubala ushintsha kanjani uma lezo zimo ziphulwa.
y-m-64-09.material: Ukuze sibheke inani lempumelelo njengelandela ukusabalaliswa kwe-binomial, (1) inani lezivivinyo kumele limiswe, (2) isivivinyo ngasinye kumele sinike enye yemiphumela emibili, impumelelo noma ukwehluleka, (3) ithuba lempumelelo kumele lifane kuzo zonke izivivinyo, futhi (4) izivivinyo akumele zithinte komunye nomunye. Sifuna ukuhlola lezi zimo ezine ezimweni ezingezansi. Ibhokisi linamabhola amhlophe angu-6 namabhola amnyama angu-4.
y-m-64-09.thinking.2: Xhumanisa umehluko wamanani nesizathu uma imodeli iphosile
y-m-64-09.prereq.0: U-'H1' kulo msebenzi uyinkomba kuphela yezinga lobunzima nokusekela ekwabiweni kwalokhu kukhiqizwa futhi akusho ukuthi ikharikhulamu inika lesi sihloko unyaka othile wesikole. Kucabanga ukuthi uhlangabezane, ku-Probability and Statistics yesikole esiphakeme, nezivivinyo ezizimele nencazelo yokusabalaliswa kwe-binomial (inani lempumelelo elibaliwe ngokuphindaphinda impumelelo ethuba elifanayo izikhathi ezingu-n).
y-m-64-09.prereq.1: Isipiliyoni sokubala inani lezindlela zokukhetha ezinye ezintweni ezihlukile
y-m-64-09.prereq.2: Isipiliyoni sokuchaza ngamazwi umehluko phakathi kokuthatha isampula ngokubuyisela nangaphandle kokubuyisela
y-m-64-09.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke izimo ezingezansi lapho 'inani lempumelelo' lingabhekwa njenge-binomial.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.hint.0: Kunketho ngayinye, hlola izimo ezine linye ngesikhathi ngaphandle kokushiya. Ikakhulukazi, hlola ukuthi ithuba lempumelelo lifana yini kuzo zonke izivivinyo.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.hint.1: Kunketho lapho ithuba libonakala lishintsha, bhala wena ukuthi ithuba lishintsha kanjani ngemuva kwesivivinyo sokuqala ukuhlola.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.o.a: Inani lamabhola amhlophe aphuma uma ukhipha amabhola ebhokisini linye ngesikhathi, uhlola umbala, ungawabuyiseli, futhi ukhipha izikhathi ezingu-5
y-m-64-09.s.s1.r.a: Isikhathi ngasinye lapho ukhipha elilodwa, isilinganiso samabhola amhlophe ebhokisini siyashintsha, ngakho ithuba lempumelelo kusivivinyo ngasinye alingaguquki.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.o.b: Inani lempumelelo uma umdlali onesilinganiso sempumelelo esingu-0.6 ephonsa izikhathi ezingu-10 zokuphonsa mahhala ngaphansi kwezimo ezifanayo, ecabanga ukuthi imiphumela yangaphambilini ayithinti imiphumela eyalandela
y-m-64-09.s.s1.r.b: Lokhu kuyikhetho elahlola ukuthi zonke izimo ezine zisemshwaneni.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.o.c: Inani lempumelelo uma umdlali ofanayo ephonsa izikhathi ezingu-10, elandela umthetho lapho isilinganiso sempumelelo esilandelayo singu-0.8 uma okwangaphambilini kwakuyimpumelelo futhi singu-0.4 uma kwakungukwehluleka
y-m-64-09.s.s1.r.c: Ithuba lempumelelo yesivivinyo lishintsha kuye ngomphumela wangaphambilini, ngakho izivivinyo zithintana.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.o.d: Inani lamabhola amhlophe aphuma uma uphinda izikhathi ezingu-5 ukukhipha ibhola elilodwa ebhokisini, uhlola umbala, futhi uliphindisela
y-m-64-09.s.s1.r.d: Lokhu kuyikhetho elahlola ukuthi, ngoba ibhola liyabuyiselwa, isimo sebhokisi sifana njalo.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.o.e: Inani lemibuzo eyaphendulwa kahle uma uqagela ngokungahleliwe yonke imibuzo engu-10 yezinketho ezine (imibuzo ayithintani)
y-m-64-09.s.s1.r.e: Lokhu kuyikhetho elahlola ukuthi ithuba lokuthola umbuzo ngamunye kulungile liyafana futhi abathintani.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.explain: Ku-b, d, no-e, inani lezivivinyo limisiwe, ithuba lempumelelo kusivivinyo ngasinye alishintshi, futhi izivivinyo azithintani. Ku-a, amabhola akhishiwe awabuyiselwa, ngakho ithuba lishintsha ngesivivinyo ngasinye, futhi ku-c, umphumela wangaphambilini ushintsha ithuba elilandelayo, ngakho izivivinyo zithintana.

y-m-64-09.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala icala elilodwa elinezimpumelelo ezingu-7 nokwehluleka okungu-3 futhi uthole ithuba laleli cala.

y-m-64-09.s.s2.r.c: Uthathe isilinganiso sezimpumelelo (7/10) njengethuba. Lihlukile kwithuba lokuthi mangaki kwangu-10 angempumelelo.
y-m-64-09.s.s2.r.d: Leli yinani elibonisa kokubili inani lezindlela zokukhetha izindawo zezingu-7 nethuba lezimpumelelo ezingu-7 nokwehluleka okungu-3.
y-m-64-09.s.s2.explain: Inani lezindlela zokukhetha izindawo zezingu-7 kwezingu-10 ngu-10C7 = 120, futhi ithuba ngalinye ngu-0.6^7 × 0.4^3 ≈ 0.001792, ngakho ukuzengeza kunika u-120 × 0.001792 ≈ 0.215.

Chaza ukuthi kungani amanani amabili ehluka, uxhumanisa nezimo zalesi simo.

y-m-64-09.s.s3.hint.1: Thola ithuba lokuthi ibhola elimhlophe liphume okwesibili futhi uliqhathanise no-0.6.
y-m-64-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Unikeze izinombolo eziqondile ezibonisa amabhola amhlophe ebhokisini encipha isikhathi ngasinye lapho likhishwa elilodwa (isibonelo, 6/10 bese kuba ngu-5/9)?
y-m-64-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Uchaze, kuhlanganise nesiqondiso, ukuthi kungani ifomula ye-binomial likhulu kunenani langempela?
y-m-64-09.s.s3.model.0: Ngoba amabhola akhishiwe awabuyiselwa, isilinganiso samabhola amhlophe ebhokisini siyashintsha isikhathi ngasinye lapho likhishwa elilodwa. Ngakho izivivinyo azizimele futhi ifomula ye-binomial iphuma likhulu kunenani langempela.

y-m-64-05.s.s1.r.c: Usuku lapho kuna imvula ezinsukwini ezintathu zonke lufakiwe kokubili "imvula namuhla," "imvula kusasa," no-"imvula ngomhla emva kokusasa," ngakho lwabalwa izikhathi eziningana. Ukwengeza kwenza kube kukhulu kunenani langempela.
y-m-64-05.s.s1.o.d: Mtshele ukuthi ngu-30%: ithuba lifana nsuku zonke, ngakho lifana ezinsukwini ezintathu
y-m-64-05.s.s1.r.d: Ukuze ithuba losuku olulodwa nethuba le-okungenani oyedwa wezinsuku ezintathu kufane, kuzodingeka kwenzeke ini? Njengoba izinsuku ziyanda, amathuba emvula ayanda.

Leli nani lincike engcabangweni 'yokuthi azithinti omunye komunye', futhi uma singazi ubudlelwano, singasho kuphela ibanga elisuka ku-30% kuya ku-90%.

Ithuba lemvula ngosuku ngalunye lisangu-30%.' Ngemva kokufunda le ncazelo, liyini ithuba lemvula okungenani ngosuku olulodwa?
y-m-64-05.s.s2.hint.0: Ngokwencazelo, qala uhlole ukuthi icala 'kuna imvula namuhla kuphela hhayi kusasa' liyenzeka yini.

y-m-64-05.s.s2.r.a: Inani langaphambilini lalincike engcabangweni yokuthi izinsuku azithinti omunye komunye. Incazelo yashintsha leyo ngcabango.

y-m-64-07.title: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwemicimbi emibili, obubonwa ekubeni ilungu lamaklabhu amabili
y-m-64-07.topic: Ukuzimela nokungahlangani kwemicimbi: ukuhlola ngesimo sobulungu
y-m-64-07.goal: Qinisekisa, ngokwakha izimo zobulungu wena, ukuthi uma imicimbi izimele kufanele kube namacala lapho yenzeka khona ndawonye, bese uchaza imibandela lapho ukuzimela nokungahlangani kubamba khona kokubili.
y-m-64-07.material: Abafundi abangu-100 esikoleni bacwaningwa ngokuthi bajoyine amaklabhu yini. Umcimbi A ngu-'ujoyine iklabhu yezibalo' futhi umcimbi B ngu-'ujoyine iklabhu yesayensi'. Abanye abafundi kungenzeka bajoyine womabili amaklabhu. Uma kukhethwa umfundi oyedwa ngokungahleliwe, imicimbi emibili ukuzimela kusho P(A∩B) = P(A)×P(B), futhi ngokwenani labafundi, 100×(inani labafundi abajoyine bobabili) = (inani lamalungu ezibalo)×(inani lamalungu esayensi).
y-m-64-07.prereq.0: 'H1' kulo msebenzi iyinkomba nje yezinga lobunzima nokusekelwa kulokhu kwabelwa kokukhiqiza futhi ayisho ukuthi ikharikhulamu inikeza lesi sifundo unyaka othile wesikole. Icabanga ukuthi usuhlangane, ku-Probability and Statistics yesikole samabanga aphezulu, nethuba lemicimbi nezincazelo zemicimbi engahlangani nemicimbi ezimele.

Uma zombili izinombolo zamalungu zingu-1 noma ngaphezulu, uhlangothi lwesokudla aluyona u-0, ngakho inani labafundi abajoyine bobabili nalo kufanele libe ngu-1 okungenani. y-m-64-08.title: Ukuklama indawo yedayisi yomkhosi esebenza kahle ngokwesilinganiso
y-m-64-08.topic: Inani elilindelekile lokuguquguqukayo okungahleliwe: ukuklama indawo yomkhosi
y-m-64-08.goal: Hlola umthetho ngomphumela ojwayelekile esikhundleni somphumela wocezu olulodwa, bese uklama imithetho eminingana ehlukile wena ngaphakathi kwebanga eliqondiwe.
y-m-64-08.material: Le yindawo yedayisi emkhosini wesikole. Umdlali ukhokha inkokhelo yokungena engu-f amaphuzu futhi ajikijele i-die elungile kanye. Uma kuphuma u-6, umdlali uthola umklomelo wamaphuzu angu-a (inkokhelo yokungena ekhokhiwe ayibuyiswa), futhi uma kuphuma enye inombolo, akukho mklomelo. Amaphuzu ayisikolo esisetshenziswa emkhosini kuphela futhi akuyona imali. Indawo ifuna ukusebenza ngenani elimisiwe elijwayelekile lamaphuzu umdlali alahlekelwa kuwo ngocezu ngalunye.
